title: USS Jackson: video of multiple erratically moving UAP at night

tellings.quote: And then he shared with me video of when he was on the USS Jackson, same region, and and they were seeing multiple erratic moving UAP at night.

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, says a Navy officer named Alexander Wiggins showed him video taken aboard the USS Jackson, a Navy warship, off Southern California around 2019. According to Gallaudet, the crew saw several UAP, unidentified objects in the sky, moving erratically at night. He tells it as part of a wider pattern of strange objects swarming Navy ships in that area.
